name: _fallback.scss
html:
// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
//  carousel/_fallback.scss — the below-threshold horizontal fallback strip
//  (no carousel controls) plus the shadow-scoped keyboard focus ring.
//  Imported by carousel.scss (manifest) — not compiled standalone.
// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

.#{$_B_CAROUSEL} {
  // ── Fallback (below threshold) ─────────────────────────────────────────
  &-fallback {
    width: 100%;
    box-sizing: border-box;
    background-color: var(--bg-dark);
    overflow-x: auto;
    scrollbar-width: none; // Firefox
    &::-webkit-scrollbar {
      display: none; // Chrome/Safari
    }

    display: block;
    white-space: nowrap;
    > * {
      display: inline-block;
    }

    // Two items that fit without carousel controls form one intrinsic-width
    // group centered in the available row. Without this modifier the generic
    // nowrap fallback starts at the left edge (visible on Nathalia Bond's two
    // tall homepage captures).
    &--side {
      display: flex;
      align-items: flex-start;
      justify-content: center;
      gap: to-rem($space-lg);
      overflow-x: visible;
      white-space: normal;

      > * {
        display: block;
        flex: 0 1 auto;
      }
    }
  }
}

// Keyboard focus ring on this shadow root's tabbable elements — the file
// doesn't import _structure (which emits it globally), so include the
// shared scope explicitly.
@include focus-ring-scope;
